summary: 56-year-old man snowmobiling with friends struck a tree near Baker Mountain (Rabbit Ears Pass vicinity) and suffered blunt force trauma. Medevac helicopter landed within a quarter mile; GCSAR members reached him on snowmobiles and transported him to the waiting helicopter, which flew him to a hospital.
location: Near Baker Mountain, vicinity of Rabbit Ears Pass
notes: Two near-identical posts (posts 1 and 2) describe the same incident; one insert with both permalinks. Rabbit Ears Pass spans Grand/Routt; set Grand per GCSAR post (run 920 parked a Routt-side lead on the Baker Mountain crash).
